what_changed: NCUA final rule removing its regulation on third-party servicing of indirect vehicle loans, effective September 8, 2026, in favor of principles-based supervision.
compliant_agent_must_now: From September 8, 2026, federally insured credit unions are no longer bound by NCUA's specific third-party servicing rule for indirect vehicle loans; oversight of servicers (including an AI servicing vendor) rests on general safety-and-soundness and vendor due-diligence expectations.
open_questions_for_deploying_team: Register gap: no row covers NCUA's (now removed) third-party servicing rule for indirect vehicle loans. Should a VENDOR.GOVERNANCE row record the removal and what replaces it?
Which credit union contracts reference the removed rule's limits, and should they be renegotiated?
